meta.purpose: Clear list of questions, verified information we already have, missing information we do NOT have (left blank & flagged), and concrete discovery suggestions required before any reasonable sell-or-renew decision.

questions.question: What is the exact primary-term expiration date within 2030–2035, and how many option periods remain?
questions.known_verified: Corporate SEC filings report aggregate system counts (2,128 units at Q1 FY2026) and do not disclose per-store expiration dates.
questions.discovery_suggestion: Have real-estate counsel abstract the executed base lease, commencement letter, and all amendments in the offline workspace.

questions.question: What are the earliest and latest option-exercise notice dates, and how must notice be served?
questions.known_verified: Commercial options in California require strict compliance with contractual notice windows and delivery methods.
questions.discovery_suggestion: Build a reconciled notice calendar with 180-day, 90-day, and 30-day counsel alerts before contacting tenant or listing brokers.

questions.question: What is the current annual base rent, option rent bump formula (fixed % vs CPI vs FMV), and percentage-rent clause?
questions.known_verified: LA metro CPI-U rose +3.7% YoY in Sept 2026; fixed bumps below ~2%/yr lose real value if inflation stays near 3.5–4.0%.
questions.discovery_suggestion: Extract rent schedule from lease + current rent ledger; benchmark contract rent/sq ft against 3 Central LA QSR BOVs.

questions.question: Is the lease truly absolute NNN, or is the landlord responsible for roof, structure, parking lot, or Prop 13 tax reassessment?
questions.known_verified: Under Proposition 13, a sale triggers reassessment to 100% of market value (1% base + voter debt).
questions.discovery_suggestion: Audit lease tax-reimbursement and maintenance clauses; if tenant pays reassessed taxes on sale, check whether jump pushes occupancy cost >10% of store sales.

questions.question: Does the tenant hold a Right of First Refusal (ROFR) or Right of First Offer (ROFO) on a sale?
questions.known_verified: Jack in the Box Inc. actively manages franchise real estate and is executing dispositions under 'JACK on Track'.
questions.discovery_suggestion: Review transfer/ROFR section of lease; if ROFR exists, structure marketing timeline around the exact response window or request a conditional waiver.

questions.question: Who is the legal tenant on PARCEL-001 (Jack in the Box Inc. corporate vs a franchisee LLC), and what guaranty backs the lease?
questions.known_verified: At Q1 FY2026, 1,979 of 2,128 Jack in the Box units (93.0%) are franchised and only 149 (7.0%) are company-operated.
questions.discovery_suggestion: Inspect lease signature block, assignment agreements, and corporate guaranty; request an estoppel certificate during underwriting.

questions.question: What are PARCEL-001's trailing 3-year gross store sales and rent-to-sales ratio?
questions.known_verified: System franchise SSS fell -4.5% (Q2'25), -7.2% (Q3'25), -7.6% (Q4'25), and -7.0% (Q1'26), while CA AB 1228 sets a $20.00/hr fast-food wage floor.
questions.discovery_suggestion: Enforce gross-sales reporting clause in the lease (required in many QSR percentage-rent leases) to compute exact occupancy cost %.

questions.question: Is PARCEL-001 a candidate for closure under the 'JACK on Track' block closure program?
questions.known_verified: JACK closed 86 units in FY2025 (51 under JACK on Track), 14 in Q1 FY2026, and guides 50–100 closures in FY2026 (mostly franchise).
questions.discovery_suggestion: Combine store sales audit, building remodel vintage, and confidential franchisee/corporate dialogue after counsel completes Gate G-02.

questions.question: Which exact Census tracts form the 1-mile and 3-mile trade area around PARCEL-001, and are their incomes/populations growing or shrinking?
questions.known_verified: City of LA population fell -0.9% YoY to 3,806,201 on Jan 1, 2026 (DOF E-1), while LA added 11,260 net housing units (62.7% multifamily).
questions.discovery_suggestion: Geocode the address offline (never in Git), lock the intersecting Census tract GEOIDs, register a free Census API key, and pull 2019 vs 2024 ACS 5-year tract series.

questions.question: What is the daytime worker density and employment trend within 1 mile of PARCEL-001?
questions.known_verified: Metro nonfarm jobs rose +0.9% YoY to 4,662.8k (Oct 2026p); Hospitality & Food Services has only 0.59 remote days/wk (SCAG), sustaining on-site meal trips.
questions.discovery_suggestion: Query Census OnTheMap / LEHD LODES workplace area characteristics offline for the locked 1-mile tract buffer.

questions.question: What is the 24-hour traffic count (AADT), ingress/egress access, and drive-thru queue capacity at PARCEL-001?
questions.known_verified: Caltrans publishes State Highway AADT (2013–2024); city surface-street counts are maintained by LADOT.
questions.discovery_suggestion: Pull LADOT traffic survey counts + Caltrans nearest ramp/highway AADT offline, and check drive-thru car-stacking count on aerial/site survey.

questions.question: How are immediate neighborhood schools performing and enrolling relative to districtwide LAUSD trends?
questions.known_verified: LAUSD enrolled 497,105 students in SY 2025-26 (16.4% English Learners); regional SCAG child population (0–17) is projected to decline from 4.2M to 3.8M by 2050.
questions.discovery_suggestion: Look up attendance-boundary schools within 0.5–1.0 miles on CDE DataQuest offline to gauge family stability vs young-adult infill shift.

questions.question: If the tenant leaves at expiry, what is PARCEL-001's underlying land value and zoning/TOC redevelopment potential (including drive-thru grandfathering)?
questions.known_verified: City of LA BOE Cadastral / ZIMAS governs parcel zoning, Transit Oriented Communities (TOC) tiers, and Conditional Use Permits; drive-thru entitlements in LA are scarce.
questions.discovery_suggestion: Pull private ZIMAS parcel profile: verify lot square footage, commercial/TOC tier, alley access, and whether drive-thru rights survive a brand change.

questions.question: Is PARCEL-001 inside a CGS Alquist-Priolo Fault Rupture or Liquefaction Zone, and what is the building's construction year / PML?
questions.known_verified: LA 30-year USGS UCERF3 probabilities are 60% (M>=6.7), 46% (M>=7.0), and 31% (M>=7.5); CGS zones trigger statutory disclosure on sale.
questions.discovery_suggestion: Run parcel coordinates privately in CGS EQ ZApp and confirm building year/retrofit from Assessor & permit records.

questions.question: What are PARCEL-001's exact FEMA NFHL flood zone and CAL FIRE 2025 LRA Fire Hazard Severity Zone designations?
questions.known_verified: FEMA NFHL and CAL FIRE 2025 LRA / Nov 2026–Jan 2027 SRA viewers provide parcel-level regulatory determinations; 11,160 LA County homes burned in Jan 2025 fires.
questions.discovery_suggestion: Download dated official FEMA FIRMette and OSFM LRA FHSZ screenshot into the private vault.

questions.question: Are property, casualty, earthquake, flood, and 12–24 month loss-of-rent policies currently in force and reasonably priced, and is there historical soil contamination?
questions.known_verified: California FAIR Plan policies rose to 677,449 across 662 distressed ZIP codes as of Nov 20, 2026 (CDI).
questions.discovery_suggestion: Audit current NNN insurance certificates, deductible caps, and historical city directories/Sanborn maps (check prior gas station or dry cleaner use before ordering a Phase I ESA).

questions.question: What cap rate will buyers pay today with 4–9 years remaining vs a fresh 10–15 year renewed lease?
questions.known_verified: 10-Year U.S. Treasury sits at 4.91% (2026-11-24), keeping commercial mortgage rates elevated and penalizing sub-7-year lease fuses.
questions.discovery_suggestion: Solicit 3 written net-lease BOVs (pricing both 'as-is' and 'extended') plus 2 commercial lender debt quotes under NDA.

questions.question: What is the owner's exact net after-tax cash from a sale today, including §1250 recapture, federal LTCG, NIIT, CA ordinary tax, and Measure ULA?
questions.known_verified: Statutory rates: 25% max §1250 recapture, 20% top federal LTCG, 3.8% NIIT, up to 13.3% CA personal income tax, plus City of LA Measure ULA above $5M.
questions.discovery_suggestion: Obtain CPA adjusted-basis & depreciation schedule, confirm whether parcel is inside City of LA boundaries (vs unincorporated/adjacent city for ULA), and run our offline browser calculator.

questions.question: Does PARCEL-001's current Prop 13 assessed value exceed fair market value ahead of the November 30, 2026 Decline-in-Value deadline?
questions.known_verified: LA County Assessor's 2026–2027 Decline-in-Value filing window closes November 30, 2026 (4 days from 2026-11-26).
questions.discovery_suggestion: Check the 2026–2027 secured tax bill immediately; if recent purchase/reassessment sits above short-lease market value, file online before Nov 30, 2026.

questions.question: How concentrated is the owner's personal balance sheet in PARCEL-001, and would a §1031 exchange preserve wealth better than a taxable sale or single-tenant hold?
questions.known_verified: IRC §1031 defers federal and CA capital-gain and §1250 recapture taxes when exchanging into qualifying U.S. real property within 45/180 days via a Qualified Intermediary.
questions.discovery_suggestion: Model 3 personal wealth paths with CPA & wealth advisor: (1) Taxable Sale, (2) §1031 Exchange into 2–3 diversified lower-hazard NNN/multifamily assets, (3) Negotiated Blend-and-Extend Hold.
